Good question! Once your return reaches our warehouse, your refund will be issued within **5 business days**. It goes back to your original payment method, minus the **$6.95** change-of-mind fee unless you're a Leafy Plus member.

- **Timing:** The 5 business days start when the parcel reaches our warehouse, not when you drop it off. Transit time comes first.
- **Bank timing:** I don't have information on how long your bank or card provider takes to show the refund once we've issued it, so I can't give you an exact date for it appearing in your account.

Since your first label expired, please start a new return from **"My Orders"** soon, and drop the parcel off within **7 days** of getting the new label. If you can't start a new return there, let me know and I'll escalate it to a Support Lead so they can sort it out.

If you don't see your refund after the 5 business days, reach out and we'll look into it. Thanks for your patience, and happy growing! 🌿
